model_annotation: The chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms for various medical specialties when fine-tuned on different datasets. The horizontal axis lists the per-specialty terms, categorized into Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, in that order. The vertical axis is labeled "Negative log probability" with a linear scale ranging from -27 to -22, with tick labels at every integer. The bars are grouped by per-specialty terms, with each group containing six bars representing different fine-tuning datasets: Mistralv0.2-Base and fine-tuned models on Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, distinguished by different shades of brown and beige. The bars are generally sorted in descending order of negative log probability within each group, with the lightest shade (Mistralv0.2-Base) consistently being the longest or among the longest bars in each category. The bars for the corresponding fine-tuned model within each per-specialty term category tend to be the shortest, such as the bar for "Cardio" fine-tuned on Cardio having a negative log probability of approximately -26.8, while the values for other fine-tuned models within the same category range from around -23 to -24.2. No bars are visually emphasized in the chart.
